name: 60605 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60605 (Chicago) has 218 nonprofit organizations. 112 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 93 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60605 (Chicago) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
45% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60605 (Chicago) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
